newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Nov 2.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Nov 2.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 1.717 million tonnes in the week ended November 2, down from 1.761 million tonnes in the previous week, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said on Wednesday.
CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week 22 of the 1996 season that average commercial cane sugar (CCS) content fell to 13.92 percent from 14.11 percent the week before.
The latest week brought this year's crush to 34.08 million tonnes, up from 29.97 million at the same time in 1995.
